decomposition.note: Thresholds are quantiles of HUMAN vote entropy on the TRAIN split only. They are fixed before any test result is seen.

shift.note: Transfer to another NLI text source (SNLI image captions): a fixed random sample of ChaosNLI-SNLI without premise overlap with MNLI, prepared before freezing and evaluated once with the frozen assessors. MNLI thresholds (0.624 / 0.683) and dev-selected policies are reused unchanged. Reported separately from the MNLI test. Same task and labels, and both ChaosNLI subsets were selected by the same low-agreement criterion: a limited transfer check, not robustness to arbitrary inputs.

interpretation_rules: Signals are compared on two observable targets; this does not identify epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty. Prompt MI first measures prompt dependence.
Cases between the thresholds (0.624 < entropy < 0.683) are not debatable: reference answer if the model matches the majority, else hedge.
The evaluated model answer is always the top label of the five-prompt mean, also in transfer (reference actions use the target model's answer).
Intervals are 95% percentile bootstraps over premise groups, not adjusted for multiple comparisons; only primary comparisons support claims, others are descriptive.
Development numbers are optimistic because trees and thresholds were selected on the same data.
